Don't scratch your head to learn Python.
Learn These Concepts to be proficient in Python.
𝐁𝐚𝐬𝐢𝐜𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐏𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐧:
-Syntax & Style
-Data Types
-Variables & Operators
-Control Flow: if/else, Loops, try/except
-Functions & Modules
𝐎𝐛𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭-𝐎𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐏𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐧:
-Classes & Objects
-Inheritance
-Polymorphism
-Encapsulation
𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐋𝐢𝐛𝐫𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐬:
-Pandas: Data Manipulation
𝐏𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐭𝐡:
-DataFrames: Creation & Access
-Filtering & Selection
-Data Cleaning: Missing Values, Duplicates
-Merging & Grouping
𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐬:
-Lists
-Tuples
-Dictionaries
-Sets
𝐅𝐢𝐥𝐞 𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠:
-Text Files
-CSV Files
-JSON Files
